scripts.name: Dev server
scripts.command: if lsof -nP -iTCP:4321 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null; then echo 'Port 4321 is busy: stop the dev server in the other worktree first' >&2; false; else npm run dev -- --port 4321; fi

scripts.name: Codex review
scripts.command: git fetch --quiet origin main && codex review --base origin/main
